task_description: Audit and fix latency issues to maximize page load speed and chat response speed. Key optimizations: (1) Cache HTML at Cloudflare edge using Cache API, (2) Cache /health in KV for 30s, (3) Add Early Hints preload headers, (4) Reduce RAG timeout from 1.5s to 0.8s, (5) Skip RAG entirely when content DB is empty/uninitialized. Frontend streaming is already in place - no changes needed there.
